verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any export path for MotherDuck data, such as exporting databases or tables to Parquet or CSV, downloading a database file, or a migration-out guide. The documented flows are inbound: uploading local DuckDB files, loading from Postgres or MySQL, and reading from S3. DuckLake with bring-your-own object storage is a related storage option, but the evidence never says it is an open-format export or a way to leave the platform, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
